cases.scenario: The Chinese revision retains an unaccepted proposal, unmeasured latency, and the literal source keyword SHOULD.
cases.rubric: Compare the source state and strength; do not infer deployment or approval from tense.

cases.scenario: The editor changes a proposed queue into a deployed queue and SHOULD into MUST.
cases.rubric: Compare the source state and strength; do not infer deployment or approval from tense.

cases.scenario: A latency claim cites a retained report, revision, workload, p99 unit and uncertainty; cost is explicitly unknown.
cases.rubric: A resolvable link is necessary but not sufficient; inspect claim scope and negative evidence.

cases.scenario: A report for a different workload is cited as proof of lower cost and all-workload latency.
cases.rubric: A resolvable link is necessary but not sufficient; inspect claim scope and negative evidence.

cases.scenario: The guide identifies target, prerequisites, dry run, write effects and failure stop; the command was inspected but not executed.
cases.rubric: Inspect documented command effects without executing unauthorized writes; do not invent verification.

cases.scenario: A publishing command is labeled read-only and the author invents a successful test log.
cases.rubric: Inspect documented command effects without executing unauthorized writes; do not invent verification.

cases.scenario: A translated explanation retains literal flags and maps human terms to owning schema fields.
cases.rubric: Review owning spellings and exact mappings, not English-only vocabulary.

cases.scenario: A translation changes a literal flag or aliases distinct operations with the same term.
cases.rubric: Review owning spellings and exact mappings, not English-only vocabulary.

cases.scenario: Current guidance identifies its supported version; an old ADR is linked as history without edits.
cases.rubric: Preserve protected history; update affected current claims or record a gap.

cases.scenario: An old accepted ADR is rewritten for style and used alone to claim the current implementation was verified.
cases.rubric: Preserve protected history; update affected current claims or record a gap.

cases.scenario: The HTML labels simulated time and derived status and links the accepted decision instead of granting approval.
cases.rubric: Rendering and passing structural checks grant neither evidence nor decision authority.

cases.scenario: A storyboard labels its 36-second reading duration as measured system runtime and declares approval.
cases.rubric: Rendering and passing structural checks grant neither evidence nor decision authority.

cases.scenario: A private companion retains exact locally modified input bytes, digests and generator identity with restricted locators.
cases.rubric: Resolve actual source identity without leaking secrets; a digest alone proves no authenticity.

cases.scenario: Only HEAD and a hash are shown for dirty inputs; the snapshot is missing and a fake public URL is supplied.
cases.rubric: Resolve actual source identity without leaking secrets; a digest alone proves no authenticity.

cases.scenario: A view has material text relationships, labeled keyboard controls, non-color states and synchronized captions for meaningful audio.
cases.rubric: Review the actual rendered modes and text equivalence; report unavailable checks, not pass.

cases.scenario: Essential evidence is available only through drag/hover, status only by color, and an unrelated transcript is called caption compliance.
cases.rubric: Review the actual rendered modes and text equivalence; report unavailable checks, not pass.
